threshold_edit_declaration: No threshold, bar or projection constant in the frozen rule was edited. The vendored scorer is a byte-identical copy of the one that produced the accepted incumbent verdict.

hydrate_then_cluster.clustered_rows: rows carrying text under the accepted hydration predicate (detail_status == 'search_hit')
hydrate_then_cluster.unclustered_context: un-hydrated shells keep a unique negative cluster_id, unclustered=true, and no cluster record
hydrate_then_cluster.projection: 2-D spectral layout (nearest-neighbour graph, k=12, random_state=42) of the clusterable rows
hydrate_then_cluster.clustering: KMeans n_clusters=max(2,min(8,n//12+1)) random_state=42 n_init=10 on the clusterable rows (the qmap rule)
hydrate_then_cluster.labels: qmap label rule: top-5 positive-mean TF-IDF terms
hydrate_then_cluster.outliers: top decile by distance to owning cluster centroid (shells measured to the nearest centroid)

relevance_ordered.clustered_rows: same clusterable row set as V1
relevance_ordered.projection: x = min-max normalised rerank score; y = query-language band (query language on top, other languages stacked below, shells in the unclustered band); deterministic rank-derived jitter
relevance_ordered.clustering: identical KMeans on the clusterable rows; cluster ids renumbered by descending mean rerank score
relevance_ordered.outliers: identical top-decile rule evaluated on the relevance layout
